question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
-- Calculate total income from Meatlovers ($12) and Vegetarian ($10) pizzas plus extras ($1 each)
-- Exclude cancelled orders
SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 12
             WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Vegetarian' THEN 10
        END + 
        CASE WHEN co.extras IS NULL OR co.extras = '' THEN 0
             ELSE array_length(string_split(co.extras, ','))
        END
    ) as total_income
FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
WHERE pn.pizza_name IN ('Meatlovers', 'Vegetarian')
  AND (ro.cancellation IS NULL OR ro.cancellation = '')
